newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Halla Group names new chairman/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Halla Group names new chairman/CEO.

text.p: Halla Group named executive vice chairman Chung Mong-won as the conglomerate's new chairman and chief executive officer, effective January 1, 1997, the group said on Monday.
Chung will replace Chung In-yung, who will be named honourary chairman, Halla said in a statement.
The group said it planned to boost sales to seven trillion won in 1997, up from 5.4 trillion expected this year.
The statement also said that Halla plans to invest a total of one trillion won in new and ongoing projects in 1997.
Halla has 17 subsidiaries, ranging in business from shipbuilding to cement production.
